newsitem.title: UK: BFI up five as Atlantic rates firm up.
newsitem.headline: BFI up five as Atlantic rates firm up.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up five points on Tuesday to 1,250 points, the first gain since May 22.
Capers continued firm in the Atlantic and Panamax rates, at least in the North Atlantic, in the opinion may brokers were now slowly improving.

Continental were said to be quoting $20.25 no combo for their end June 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan and were also said to be willing to consider timecharter for their June stem of 55,000 heavy grain USGulf to Egypt.
Conditions in the Pacific remained quiet for Capers and Panamaxes but brokers said that Handy-size rates from PNW were increasing.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 20 to 10 points higher and turnover totalled 71 lots.
